name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is advancing its flagship Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta, Argentina toward production. The company completed a Definitive Feasibility Study in 2026 showing a 25-year mine life and is in the development stage, having awarded a bridging engineering contract in August 2026 and targeting first production in 2029.
